description: Cruel Summer is THAT song that should've been a single from day one and mother let it flop for YEARS and I'm still mad about it 😤🔥 'I love you ain't that the worst thing you ever heard' ugh the bridge of the century. It's the Lover era's only true banger and I scream it in the car like I'm at a stadium. She finally made it a single and we all won, but the disrespect was real 💅✨
